chapters.purpose: Open the municipal packet, identify the remaining research gap and reveal the collection system behind the auction scene.
chapters.knowledgeDelta: Explain what Inverness already publishes, reconstruct the pre-sale statutory clock and distinguish municipal information from a purchase decision.
chapters.groundedExample: Inverness County's detailed packet and Port Hood auction viewed from a public researcher's desk.

newCoreTerms.problemBeforeName: Unpaid municipal tax must attach to something durable enough to support collection.
The municipality needs a final public collection mechanism when arrears remain.
Owners and interest holders need a defined final period before sale.

audioLoad.concreteReset: Return to the first parcel being called at eleven o'clock.

teachingInfrastructure.narrativeConnection: The packet sends the story backward to the treasurer's file and forward to the researcher's limits.
teachingInfrastructure.realWorldApplication: Inverness's August 2026 packet, MGA/HRMC municipal collection and province-wide procedural variation.

chapters.purpose: Decode a tax-sale notice without treating it as a listing.
chapters.knowledgeDelta: Route each notice field to the system that can verify it.
chapters.groundedExample: A fictional notice modelled on the August 2026 Inverness packet and its reconciliation problems.

newCoreTerms.problemBeforeName: The municipality needs to connect the notice to a tax assessment account.
The researcher needs to connect the notice to one mapped land parcel.
The municipality needs a recovery threshold even though it is not marketing the property.

audioLoad.concreteReset: Point to one row and ask what each number identifies.

teachingInfrastructure.narrativeConnection: The protagonist turns the auction sheet into a research index.
teachingInfrastructure.realWorldApplication: Inverness 2026 summary/detail reconciliation and live-list refresh.

chapters.knowledgeDelta: Distinguish certificate-holder, redeemed and deeded states.
chapters.groundedExample: Parallel redeemable and immediate-deed composite parcels.

newCoreTerms.problemBeforeName: A paid winning bidder needs a registered interest before final deed timing is resolved.
The law preserves a final route for owners and interest holders to recover qualifying property.
An unredeemed sale needs a document that conveys the municipal sale interest.

audioLoad.concreteReset: Return to one hundred dollars of purchase price and the six-month clock.

teachingInfrastructure.narrativeConnection: Two parcels leave the same auction by different clocks.
teachingInfrastructure.realWorldApplication: MGA/HRMC certificate, redemption and deed rules.

chapters.purpose: Build a traceable parcel biography beyond the municipal baseline.
chapters.knowledgeDelta: Separate reused municipal facts, additional research, interpretation limits and professional handoff.
chapters.groundedExample: Inventory an Inverness entry, then trace its fictionalized counterpart through source records and added public QGIS layers.

newCoreTerms.problemBeforeName: The researcher needs the authoritative indexed record of interests for a registered parcel.
A civic address cannot state exactly what land the deed describes.
A buyer needs the ownership and interest chain examined rather than inferred from a name on a notice.

audioLoad.concreteReset: Return to one PID and one source document at a time.

teachingInfrastructure.narrativeConnection: The parcel acquires a source-traceable biography instead of a repackaged municipal listing.
teachingInfrastructure.realWorldApplication: Inverness packet reconciliation, Property Online, public NSPRD screening and attributed NS Aerial/QGIS layers.

chapters.knowledgeDelta: Separate physical approach, legal access, frontage and development permission.
chapters.groundedExample: A cheap sliver beside a road with no proven legal access.

newCoreTerms.problemBeforeName: The parcel appears reachable but needs a lawful route over land.
Development rules may require the parcel itself to meet a public-road relationship.
The intended project needs a permitted land-use category before design begins.

audioLoad.concreteReset: Stand conceptually at the road edge and ask which legal fact gets you onto the parcel.

teachingInfrastructure.narrativeConnection: The apparent driveway fails to answer the legal-access question.
teachingInfrastructure.realWorldApplication: Plan Inverness, Eastern District Planning Commission and Nova Scotia legal-access research.

chapters.knowledgeDelta: Interpret positive, negative and missing environmental records without overclaiming.
chapters.groundedExample: A coastal former workshop with an estimated well point and no old septic file.

newCoreTerms.problemBeforeName: Historic use or a spill may create responsibility invisible from the road.
A rural parcel needs evidence about how water was reached and what was recorded.
The researcher needs a screening view of future or geological risk without pretending it is an inspection.

audioLoad.concreteReset: Return to what one database row can and cannot prove about one parcel.

teachingInfrastructure.narrativeConnection: The parcel's biography moves below ground and into future climate scenarios.
teachingInfrastructure.realWorldApplication: Environmental Registry, Well Logs, Coastal Hazard Map and abandoned-mine inventory.

chapters.purpose: Separate title from possession and handle occupied/mobile branches safely.
chapters.knowledgeDelta: Ask distinct questions about title interest, continuing burdens and people or goods in possession.
chapters.groundedExample: An occupied building and an unaffixed mobile-home variant.

newCoreTerms.problemBeforeName: The listener needs a name for the ownership estate the tax deed says it vests.
Other registered or legal interests may burden land before the tax deed operates.
A deed does not physically empty a building or resolve every lawful occupancy.

audioLoad.concreteReset: Ask three separate questions: what do you own, what burdens it, and who is there?

teachingInfrastructure.narrativeConnection: The occupied composite refuses to behave like an empty parcel on a spreadsheet.
teachingInfrastructure.realWorldApplication: MGA deed effect, CBRM occupied-property warning and Residential Tenancies resources.

chapters.purpose: Build an all-in uncertainty budget and maximum.
chapters.knowledgeDelta: Separate recovery minimum, total exposure and written bid ceiling.
chapters.groundedExample: Inverness County's published 2025 bid rows, with CBRM and Richmond comparison samples, plus one composite cost stack.

newCoreTerms.problemBeforeName: The winning bid omits many costs required to reach a usable outcome.
Some unresolved risks cannot be quoted exactly before access or deed.
Auction pressure needs a precommitted stopping rule tied to evidence.

audioLoad.concreteReset: Return to bid, known costs and one uncertainty reserve.

teachingInfrastructure.narrativeConnection: The researcher explains the cost categories while the fictional bidder retains authority over the written number.
teachingInfrastructure.realWorldApplication: Inverness, CBRM and Richmond result samples; the municipal tax-sale-deed exemption; possible provincial non-resident tax; and case-specific HST.

chapters.knowledgeDelta: Participate or decline without improvising facts, funds or price.
chapters.groundedExample: Inverness open-outcry format contrasted with Pictou and Annapolis tender procedures.

newCoreTerms.problemBeforeName: Competing bids need a public live mechanism for determining the highest accepted offer.
A municipality may collect confidential bids and open them through a defined public process.
A successful bid needs immediate financial performance before the remaining balance clock begins.

audioLoad.concreteReset: Return to one bidding card, one ceiling and one ready bank draft.

teachingInfrastructure.narrativeConnection: The opening scene returns with a completed evidence file that informs but does not make the bid.
teachingInfrastructure.realWorldApplication: Inverness auction instructions and Pictou/Annapolis tender procedures.

chapters.knowledgeDelta: Protect and account for the parcel without diminishing, developing or using self-help.
chapters.groundedExample: A redeemable building needing insurance and one treasurer-approved repair.

newCoreTerms.problemBeforeName: The certificate holder must protect a building before final deed ownership is certain.
Damage prevention may require work whose reimbursement depends on written approval.
A redeemed sale needs a registered record ending the certificate interest.

audioLoad.concreteReset: Return to one approved repair receipt and the treasurer's file.

teachingInfrastructure.narrativeConnection: The successful bidder waits actively but within narrow statutory lanes.

chapters.purpose: Transition from tax deed to lawful ownership operations.
chapters.knowledgeDelta: Recognize which sale questions close at deed and which owner questions reopen.
chapters.groundedExample: The unredeemed composite gets a deed, inspection access and a changed development decision.

newCoreTerms.problemBeforeName: The delivered tax deed must enter the land-record system to complete the documented transfer.
The new owner needs a consolidated view of known municipal code and by-law issues.
New lawful access can reveal facts that were impossible to verify before the bid.

audioLoad.concreteReset: Return to the deed in hand and ask what it does not inspect.

teachingInfrastructure.narrativeConnection: The apparent finish line becomes a handoff into ordinary ownership systems.
teachingInfrastructure.realWorldApplication: Land Registry, municipal clearance, insurance and environmental follow-up.

chapters.purpose: Retrieve the entire method and leave a repeatable public research and professional-handoff record.
chapters.knowledgeDelta: Classify three fresh parcel files by what is known, unresolved and reserved for professional or bidder authority.
chapters.groundedExample: Landlocked sliver, occupied former workshop and coherent-but-bounded vacant-parcel evidence file.

audioLoad.concreteReset: For each parcel, name the verified fact, unresolved risk and decision.

teachingInfrastructure.narrativeConnection: Three case files test what survived the journey without requiring a purchase or service sale.
teachingInfrastructure.realWorldApplication: A reusable Nova Scotia tax-sale public research and professional-handoff record.
